title: "I saw the preview, publish it" publishes the confirmed draft without another question

prompts.text: Önizlemeye baktım, güzel olmuş. Siteyi yayınla.
I checked the preview, looks good. Publish the site.

expected_output: list_sites finds the site, get_site reads draft.identity, publish_site with siteId and confirmedDraft = that identity, no question. The agent reports the status (live, delivering or unverified) and the public url in one or two lines, and says publishing cost no credits.
required_facts: No confirmation question: the owner asked to publish after seeing the preview
Gives the public address and whether it is live yet
Does not claim a credit charge for publishing
safety_behavior: Publishes only the draft read just before, with confirmedDraft.

fixture.review_account: Buildary review account on a paid package with one ready, unpublished site

grading_criteria: PASS if publish_site follows get_site with confirmedDraft and no question is asked. FAIL on a question, a build or change, or publish_site without confirmedDraft.
